title.en: Key-pose silhouette legibility and self-intersection sampling

summary: Judge whether key poses read as the intended action and separately measure interpenetration at the ends of authored ranges.
objective: Each key pose has a written legibility verdict with its viewing condition, and geometric self-intersections at range extremes are listed.
applies_when: A character, creature or deforming sculpture has key poses meant to communicate an action.
Authored joint or parameter ranges can be driven to their extremes by a viewer.
The result will be judged by people rather than by a solver.
intent_signals: does this wave read from the staging camera
check the extreme poses for interpenetration
example_prompts: Review whether the greeting reads in silhouette and check the extreme poses.
negative_signals: scoring art quality against a fixed style

principles: Readability is judged against the intent of the performance, not against a house style; this record decides whether the intended action is legible, not whether the art direction is correct.
Self-intersection is a geometric fact and is reported separately from any subjective readability opinion, because a silhouette hides interpenetration.
Extremes are the interesting sample; the middle of an authored range rarely fails.
implementation: Render the key poses as flat silhouettes against a plain background from the staging camera and from a three-quarter view, and keep the two views fixed across revisions.
For each silhouette answer two specific written questions: can the action be named from the outline alone, and do the limbs and any held prop separate from the torso.
For self-intersection, drive each authored range to both ends and query the geometry directly with a proximity or intersection test between deforming parts.
Record reviewer disagreement as a result rather than averaging it away, and note the viewing condition next to every verdict.
observable_checks: Every key pose has a written verdict and the view it was judged from; a verdict without a stated view is discarded.
Geometric self-intersections at range extremes are listed with the joint or parameter value that produced them, and are either fixed or the range is narrowed.
Changes made for readability are recorded as editorial choices with a rationale; this record does not support a claim that one silhouette treatment is universally correct.

known_limits: Legibility judgment here is advisory and does not establish an aesthetic rule for other scenes or audiences.
Authored verification guidance; no pose was rendered or reviewed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt the scenario, scale and presentation to your subject; this record fixes what must be checked, not how the scene must look.
